content:
We’ve been sent a GEEKOM A5 2027 Edition mini PC powered by an AMD Ryzen 7 7730U 8-core/16-thread CPU for review. The mini PC supports up to 64GB dual-channel DDR5-5600MHz memory, can drive up to four independent displays via HDMI 2.0 and USB-C ports, includes three USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-A ports, two USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C ports, one USB 2.0 port, a full-size SD card reader, a 2.5GbE port, and Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.4 wireless connectivity. The model sent for review ships with 16GB DDR4 SO-DIMM RAM and a 512GB M.2 SSD pre-loaded with an activated Windows 11 Pro operating system. In the first part of the review, we’ll list the specifications, perform an unboxing and teardown to check out the hardware, and boot Windows 11 to make sure it works properly.
